abstract.para: The topic describes how to check if PCP metrics are collected properly.

topic.para: After you enable the PCP services, you can verify that metrics are being recorded properly by running the following command:
topic.screen:
&prompt.sudo;pcp
Performance Co-Pilot configuration on node1:
platform: Linux node1 6.12.0-160099.49-default #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu Aug 6 09:32:38 UTC 2026 (e38429b) x86_64 hardware: 2 cpus, 1 disk, 1 node, 3917MB RAM timezone: UTC services: pmcd pmproxy pmcd: Version 6.3.8-1, 9 agents, 1 client pmda: root pmcd proc pmproxy xfs linux mmv kvm jbd2 pmlogger: primary logger: /var/log/pcp/pmlogger/node1/20260607.09.24
topic.para: Now check if the logs are written to a proper destination:
where PATH_TO_PMLOGGER_LOGS should be /var/log/pcp/pmlogger/HOSTNAME/, with HOSTNAME being the machine's own host name, the output of the hostname command—for example, /var/log/pcp/pmlogger/node1/.
